translations.english: The minimum alt above home the vehicle will climb to before returning.  If the vehicle is flying higher than this value it will return at its current altitude.
translations.chinese: 返航开始时的最低目标高度，单位为厘米，相对于 Home 点。当前位置低于该高度时先爬升；如果已经更高，则按当前高度返航。

translations.english: This is the altitude the vehicle will move to as the final stage of Returning to Launch or after completing a mission.  Set to zero to land.
translations.chinese: 返航最后阶段或任务完成后到达的最终高度，单位为厘米。设为 0 表示降落。

translations.english: Time (in milliseconds) to loiter above home before beginning final descent
translations.chinese: 返航到 Home 点上方后，在开始最后下降前的悬停等待时间，单位为毫秒。

translations.english: Determines how the autopilot controls the yaw during missions and RTL
translations.chinese: 设置任务飞行及返航过程中，自动驾驶仪如何控制机头朝向（偏航）。各选项的区别见原始编号对应的中英文枚举。

translations.english: Never change yaw
translations.chinese: 不自动改变偏航朝向

translations.english: Face next waypoint
translations.chinese: 朝向下一个航点

translations.english: Face next waypoint except RTL
translations.chinese: 朝向下一个航点，返航期间除外

translations.english: Face along GPS course
translations.chinese: 沿 GPS 航迹方向

translations.english: The maximum vertical ascending velocity the pilot may request in cm/s
translations.chinese: 飞手可请求的最大垂直上升速度，单位为厘米/秒。

translations.english: Defines the speed in cm/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain horizontally during a WP mission
translations.chinese: 航点任务中的目标水平速度，单位为厘米/秒；飞行器会尝试保持这一速度。

translations.english: The minimum alt above home the vehicle will climb to before returning.  If the vehicle is flying higher than this value it will return at its current altitude.
translations.chinese: 返航开始时的最低目标高度，单位为厘米，相对于 Home 点。当前位置低于该高度时先爬升；如果已经更高，则按当前高度返航。

translations.english: Defines the speed in cm/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain horizontally during a WP mission
translations.chinese: 航点任务中的目标水平速度，单位为厘米/秒；飞行器会尝试保持这一速度。

translations.english: The maximum vertical ascending velocity the pilot may request in m/s
translations.chinese: 飞手可请求的最大垂直上升速度，单位为米/秒。

translations.english: The minimum alt above home the vehicle will climb to before returning. If the vehicle is flying higher than this value it will return at its current altitude.
translations.chinese: 返航开始时的最低目标高度，单位为米，相对于 Home 点。当前位置低于该高度时先爬升；如果已经更高，则按当前高度返航。

translations.english: Altitude the vehicle will move to as the final stage of Returning to Launch or after completing a mission. Set to zero to land.
translations.chinese: 返航最后阶段或任务完成后到达的最终高度，单位为米。设为 0 表示降落。

translations.english: Speed in m/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain horizontally during a WP mission
translations.chinese: 航点任务中的目标水平速度，单位为米/秒；飞行器会尝试保持这一速度。

translations.english: Defines the maximum distance from a waypoint that when crossed indicates the waypoint may be complete. To avoid the aircraft looping around the waypoint in case it misses by more than the WP_RADIUS an additional check is made to see if the aircraft has crossed a "finish line" passing through the waypoint and perpendicular to the flight path from the previous waypoint. If that finish line is crossed then the waypoint is considered complete. Note that the navigation controller may decide to turn later than WP_RADIUS before a waypoint, based on how sharp the turn is and the speed of the aircraft. It is safe to set WP_RADIUS much larger than the usual turn radius of your aircraft and the navigation controller will work out when to turn. If you set WP_RADIUS too small then you will tend to overshoot the turns.
translations.chinese: 航点完成判定所用的距离阈值，单位为米。进入该距离后，航点可被判定为完成；即使没有进入该半径，越过经过航点、且垂直于上一段航线的“终点线”，也会被判定完成，以免飞机反复绕回。实际转弯时机还取决于转角和速度，不能把这个参数当作固定的转弯半径；设置过小容易冲过转弯位置。

translations.english: Target cruise airspeed in m/s in automatic throttle modes. Value is as an indicated (calibrated/apparent) airspeed.
translations.chinese: 自动油门模式下的目标巡航空速，单位为米/秒。这里使用的是指示（校准/表观）空速。

translations.english: Target altitude above home for RTL mode. Maintains current altitude if set to -1. Rally point altitudes are used if plane does not return to home.
translations.chinese: RTL 返航的目标高度，单位为米，相对于 Home 点。设为 -1 时保持当前高度；若飞机返回的是 Rally 集结点而非 Home，则使用该集结点的高度。

translations.english: The altitude which QRTL mode heads to initially
translations.chinese: QRTL 模式最初飞向的目标高度，单位为米。原文仅说明这一阶段的目标，未在此条目中定义高度参考面。

translations.english: If this is set to 1 then an RTL will change to QRTL when within RTL_RADIUS meters of the RTL destination, VTOL approach: vehicle will RTL at RTL alt and circle with a radius of Q_FW_LND_APR_RAD down to Q_RTL_ALT and then transition into the wind and QRTL, see 'AUTO VTOL Landing', QRTL Always: do a QRTL instead of RTL
translations.chinese: 设置固定翼 RTL 与垂直起降 QRTL 的衔接方式。1：进入距返航目标 RTL_RADIUS 米范围后，从 RTL 转为 QRTL。2：先以 RTL 高度返航，再以 Q_FW_LND_APR_RAD 为半径盘旋下降到 Q_RTL_ALT，随后迎风转换并执行 QRTL（参见官方 AUTO VTOL Landing）。3：始终以 QRTL 代替 RTL。0：不启用该切换选项。

translations.english: Disabled
translations.chinese: 禁用此切换选项

translations.english: Enabled
translations.chinese: 启用近目标切换

translations.english: VTOL approach
translations.chinese: 垂直起降进近

translations.english: QRTL Always
translations.chinese: 始终使用 QRTL

translations.english: Defines the speed in cm/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain horizontally during a WP mission
translations.chinese: 垂直起降航点任务中的目标水平速度，单位为厘米/秒；飞行器会尝试保持这一速度。

translations.english: Defines the speed in cm/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain horizontally during a WP mission
translations.chinese: 垂直起降航点任务中的目标水平速度，单位为厘米/秒；飞行器会尝试保持这一速度。

translations.english: Speed in m/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain horizontally during a WP mission
translations.chinese: 垂直起降航点任务中的目标水平速度，单位为米/秒；飞行器会尝试保持这一速度。

translations.english: Pitch axis angle controller P gain.  Converts the error between the desired pitch angle and actual angle to a desired pitch rate
translations.chinese: 俯仰角度控制器的比例（P）增益：将目标角度与实际角度的偏差转换成目标俯仰角速度。

translations.english: Roll axis angle controller P gain.  Converts the error between the desired roll angle and actual angle to a desired roll rate
translations.chinese: 横滚角度控制器的比例（P）增益：将目标角度与实际角度的偏差转换成目标横滚角速度。

translations.english: Yaw axis angle controller P gain.  Converts the error between the desired yaw angle and actual angle to a desired yaw rate
translations.chinese: 偏航角度控制器的比例（P）增益：将目标角度与实际角度的偏差转换成目标偏航角速度。

translations.english: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is <= 1230
translations.chinese: 飞行模式通道 FLTMODE_CH 的 PWM ≤ 1230 时使用的飞行模式。

translations.english: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is >1230, <= 1360
translations.chinese: 飞行模式通道 FLTMODE_CH 的 PWM > 1230 且 ≤ 1360 时使用的飞行模式。

translations.english: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is >1360, <= 1490
translations.chinese: 飞行模式通道 FLTMODE_CH 的 PWM > 1360 且 ≤ 1490 时使用的飞行模式。

translations.english: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is >1490, <= 1620
translations.chinese: 飞行模式通道 FLTMODE_CH 的 PWM > 1490 且 ≤ 1620 时使用的飞行模式。

translations.english: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is >1620, <= 1749
translations.chinese: 飞行模式通道 FLTMODE_CH 的 PWM > 1620 且 ≤ 1749 时使用的飞行模式。

translations.english: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is >=1750
translations.chinese: 飞行模式通道 FLTMODE_CH 的 PWM ≥ 1750 时使用的飞行模式。

translations.english: RC Channel to use for flight mode control
translations.chinese: 选择用于切换飞行模式的遥控通道。

translations.english: Filter cutoff frequency for accelerometers. This can be set to a lower value to try to cope with very high vibration levels in aircraft. A value of zero means no filtering (not recommended!)
translations.chinese: 加速度计低通滤波的截止频率。降低该值可尝试缓解高振动的影响；设为 0 表示不滤波，官方不建议这样设置。

translations.english: Filter cutoff frequency for gyroscopes. This can be set to a lower value to try to cope with very high vibration levels in aircraft. A value of zero means no filtering (not recommended!)
translations.chinese: 陀螺仪低通滤波的截止频率。降低该值可尝试缓解高振动的影响；设为 0 表示不滤波，官方不建议这样设置。

translations.english: If LOG_DISARMED is set to 1 then logging will be enabled at all times including when disarmed. Logging before arming can make for very large logfiles but can help a lot when tracking down startup issues and is necessary if logging of EKF replay data is selected via the LOG_REPLAY parameter. If LOG_DISARMED is set to 2, then logging will be enabled when disarmed, but not if a USB connection is detected. This can be used to prevent unwanted data logs being generated when the vehicle is connected via USB for log downloading or parameter changes. If LOG_DISARMED is set to 3 then logging will happen while disarmed, but if the vehicle never arms then the logs using the filesystem backend will be discarded on the next boot.
translations.chinese: 控制未解锁时的日志记录。1：包括未解锁阶段在内始终记录，有助于排查启动问题，但日志可能很大；使用 LOG_REPLAY 记录 EKF 重放数据时需要飞行前记录。2：未解锁时记录，但检测到 USB 连接时不记录，可避免下载日志或改参数时产生无用日志。3：未解锁时记录，但若本次运行始终没有解锁，文件系统后端的这些日志会在下次启动时丢弃。

translations.english: If LOG_REPLAY is set to 1 then the EKF2 and EKF3 state estimators will log detailed information needed for diagnosing problems with the Kalman filter. LOG_DISARMED must be set to 1 or 2 or else the log will not contain the pre-flight data required for replay testing of the EKF's. It is suggested that you also raise LOG_FILE_BUFSIZE to give more buffer space for logging and use a high quality microSD card to ensure no sensor data is lost.
translations.chinese: 设为 1 时，EKF2 和 EKF3 会记录诊断卡尔曼滤波问题所需的详细数据。LOG_DISARMED 还须设为 1 或 2，否则缺少重放测试需要的飞行前数据。官方建议增大 LOG_FILE_BUFSIZE，并使用优质 microSD 卡，避免传感器数据丢失。

translations.english: Loiter maximum pilot requested lean angle. Set to zero for 2/3 of PSC_ANGLE_MAX/ANGLE_MAX. The maximum vehicle lean angle is still limited by PSC_ANGLE_MAX/ANGLE_MAX
translations.chinese: Loiter 模式中飞手可请求的最大倾斜角。设为 0 时使用 PSC_ANGLE_MAX/ANGLE_MAX 的 2/3；飞行器实际最大倾斜角仍受 PSC_ANGLE_MAX/ANGLE_MAX 限制。

translations.english: Loiter brake start delay (in seconds)
translations.chinese: Loiter 模式开始制动前的延迟，单位为秒。

translations.english: Altitude during Landing at which vehicle slows to LAND_SPEED
translations.chinese: 降落时下降到此高度后，减速到 LAND_SPEED。

translations.english: The descent speed for the first stage of landing in cm/s. If this is zero then WPNAV_SPEED_DN is used
translations.chinese: 降落第一阶段的下降速度，单位为厘米/秒。设为 0 时使用 WPNAV_SPEED_DN。

translations.english: Loiter maximum correction acceleration in cm/s/s.  Higher values cause the copter to correct position errors more aggressively.
translations.chinese: Loiter 位置修正的最大加速度，单位为厘米/秒²。增大该值会更积极地修正位置偏差。

translations.english: Loiter braking acceleration in cm/s/s. Higher values stop the copter more quickly when the stick is centered.
translations.chinese: Loiter 制动加速度，单位为厘米/秒²。增大该值可在摇杆回中后更快停止运动。

translations.english: Loiter braking jerk in cm/s/s/s. Higher values will remove braking faster if the pilot moves the sticks during a braking maneuver.
translations.chinese: Loiter 制动加加速度（加速度变化率），单位为厘米/秒³。制动过程中若飞手再次移动摇杆，较大值会更快解除制动。

translations.english: Defines the maximum speed in cm/s which the aircraft will travel horizontally while in loiter mode
translations.chinese: Loiter 模式允许的最大水平速度，单位为厘米/秒。

translations.english: The vertical acceleration used when pilot is controlling the altitude
translations.chinese: 飞手控制高度时使用的垂直加速度。

translations.english: The maximum vertical descending velocity the pilot may request in cm/s.  If 0 PILOT_SPEED_UP value is used.
translations.chinese: 飞手可请求的最大垂直下降速度，单位为厘米/秒。设为 0 时沿用 PILOT_SPEED_UP。

translations.english: The vehicle will climb this many cm during the initial climb portion of the RTL
translations.chinese: 返航最初爬升阶段需爬升的高度增量，单位为厘米。

translations.english: Defines the speed in cm/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain horizontally while flying home. If this is set to zero, WPNAV_SPEED will be used instead.
translations.chinese: 返航途中的目标水平速度，单位为厘米/秒。设为 0 时使用 WPNAV_SPEED。

translations.english: Defines the horizontal acceleration in cm/s/s used during missions
translations.chinese: 任务飞行使用的水平加速度，单位为厘米/秒²。

translations.english: Defines the vertical acceleration in cm/s/s used during missions
translations.chinese: 任务飞行使用的垂直加速度，单位为厘米/秒²。

translations.english: Defines the distance from a waypoint, that when crossed indicates the wp has been hit.
translations.chinese: 航点到达判定的距离阈值；进入该距离即认为到达此航点。

translations.english: Defines the speed in cm/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain while descending during a WP mission
translations.chinese: 航点任务中的目标下降速度，单位为厘米/秒；飞行器会尝试保持此速度。

translations.english: Defines the speed in cm/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain while climbing during a WP mission
translations.chinese: 航点任务中的目标爬升速度，单位为厘米/秒；飞行器会尝试保持此速度。

translations.english: Pitch axis angle controller P gain.  Converts the error between the desired pitch angle and actual angle to a desired pitch rate
translations.chinese: 俯仰角度控制器的比例（P）增益：将目标角度与实际角度的偏差转换成目标俯仰角速度。

translations.english: Roll axis angle controller P gain.  Converts the error between the desired roll angle and actual angle to a desired roll rate
translations.chinese: 横滚角度控制器的比例（P）增益：将目标角度与实际角度的偏差转换成目标横滚角速度。

translations.english: Yaw axis angle controller P gain.  Converts the error between the desired yaw angle and actual angle to a desired yaw rate
translations.chinese: 偏航角度控制器的比例（P）增益：将目标角度与实际角度的偏差转换成目标偏航角速度。

translations.english: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is <= 1230
translations.chinese: 飞行模式通道 FLTMODE_CH 的 PWM ≤ 1230 时使用的飞行模式。

translations.english: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is >1230, <= 1360
translations.chinese: 飞行模式通道 FLTMODE_CH 的 PWM > 1230 且 ≤ 1360 时使用的飞行模式。

translations.english: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is >1360, <= 1490
translations.chinese: 飞行模式通道 FLTMODE_CH 的 PWM > 1360 且 ≤ 1490 时使用的飞行模式。

translations.english: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is >1490, <= 1620
translations.chinese: 飞行模式通道 FLTMODE_CH 的 PWM > 1490 且 ≤ 1620 时使用的飞行模式。

translations.english: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is >1620, <= 1749
translations.chinese: 飞行模式通道 FLTMODE_CH 的 PWM > 1620 且 ≤ 1749 时使用的飞行模式。

translations.english: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is >=1750
translations.chinese: 飞行模式通道 FLTMODE_CH 的 PWM ≥ 1750 时使用的飞行模式。

translations.english: RC Channel to use for flight mode control
translations.chinese: 选择用于切换飞行模式的遥控通道。

translations.chinese: 飞手可请求的最大垂直下降速度，单位为厘米/秒。设为 0 时沿用 PILOT_SPEED_UP。

translations.english: The vehicle will climb this many cm during the initial climb portion of the RTL
translations.chinese: 返航最初爬升阶段需爬升的高度增量，单位为厘米。

translations.english: Defines the speed in cm/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain horizontally while flying home. If this is set to zero, WPNAV_SPEED will be used instead.
translations.chinese: 返航途中的目标水平速度，单位为厘米/秒。设为 0 时使用 WPNAV_SPEED。

translations.english: Defines the horizontal acceleration in cm/s/s used during missions
translations.chinese: 任务飞行使用的水平加速度，单位为厘米/秒²。

translations.english: Defines the vertical acceleration in cm/s/s used during missions
translations.chinese: 任务飞行使用的垂直加速度，单位为厘米/秒²。

translations.english: Defines the distance from a waypoint, that when crossed indicates the wp has been hit.
translations.chinese: 航点到达判定的距离阈值；进入该距离即认为到达此航点。

translations.english: Defines the speed in cm/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain while descending during a WP mission
translations.chinese: 航点任务中的目标下降速度，单位为厘米/秒；飞行器会尝试保持此速度。

translations.english: Defines the speed in cm/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain while climbing during a WP mission
translations.chinese: 航点任务中的目标爬升速度，单位为厘米/秒；飞行器会尝试保持此速度。

translations.english: Pitch axis angle controller P gain.  Converts the error between the desired pitch angle and actual angle to a desired pitch rate
translations.chinese: 俯仰角度控制器的比例（P）增益：将目标角度与实际角度的偏差转换成目标俯仰角速度。

translations.english: Roll axis angle controller P gain.  Converts the error between the desired roll angle and actual angle to a desired roll rate
translations.chinese: 横滚角度控制器的比例（P）增益：将目标角度与实际角度的偏差转换成目标横滚角速度。

translations.english: Yaw axis angle controller P gain.  Converts the error between the desired yaw angle and actual angle to a desired yaw rate
translations.chinese: 偏航角度控制器的比例（P）增益：将目标角度与实际角度的偏差转换成目标偏航角速度。

translations.english: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is <= 1230
translations.chinese: 飞行模式通道 FLTMODE_CH 的 PWM ≤ 1230 时使用的飞行模式。

translations.english: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is >1230, <= 1360
translations.chinese: 飞行模式通道 FLTMODE_CH 的 PWM > 1230 且 ≤ 1360 时使用的飞行模式。

translations.english: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is >1360, <= 1490
translations.chinese: 飞行模式通道 FLTMODE_CH 的 PWM > 1360 且 ≤ 1490 时使用的飞行模式。

translations.english: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is >1490, <= 1620
translations.chinese: 飞行模式通道 FLTMODE_CH 的 PWM > 1490 且 ≤ 1620 时使用的飞行模式。

translations.english: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is >1620, <= 1749
translations.chinese: 飞行模式通道 FLTMODE_CH 的 PWM > 1620 且 ≤ 1749 时使用的飞行模式。

translations.english: Flight mode when pwm of Flightmode channel(FLTMODE_CH) is >=1750
translations.chinese: 飞行模式通道 FLTMODE_CH 的 PWM ≥ 1750 时使用的飞行模式。

translations.english: RC Channel to use for flight mode control
translations.chinese: 选择用于切换飞行模式的遥控通道。

translations.english: Filter cutoff frequency for accelerometers. This can be set to a lower value to try to cope with very high vibration levels in aircraft. A value of zero means no filtering (not recommended!)
translations.chinese: 加速度计低通滤波的截止频率。降低该值可尝试缓解高振动的影响；设为 0 表示不滤波，官方不建议这样设置。

translations.english: Filter cutoff frequency for gyroscopes. This can be set to a lower value to try to cope with very high vibration levels in aircraft. A value of zero means no filtering (not recommended!)
translations.chinese: 陀螺仪低通滤波的截止频率。降低该值可尝试缓解高振动的影响；设为 0 表示不滤波，官方不建议这样设置。

translations.english: If LOG_DISARMED is set to 1 then logging will be enabled at all times including when disarmed. Logging before arming can make for very large logfiles but can help a lot when tracking down startup issues and is necessary if logging of EKF replay data is selected via the LOG_REPLAY parameter. If LOG_DISARMED is set to 2, then logging will be enabled when disarmed, but not if a USB connection is detected. This can be used to prevent unwanted data logs being generated when the vehicle is connected via USB for log downloading or parameter changes. If LOG_DISARMED is set to 3 then logging will happen while disarmed, but if the vehicle never arms then the logs using the filesystem backend will be discarded on the next boot.
translations.chinese: 控制未解锁时的日志记录。1：包括未解锁阶段在内始终记录，有助于排查启动问题，但日志可能很大；使用 LOG_REPLAY 记录 EKF 重放数据时需要飞行前记录。2：未解锁时记录，但检测到 USB 连接时不记录，可避免下载日志或改参数时产生无用日志。3：未解锁时记录，但若本次运行始终没有解锁，文件系统后端的这些日志会在下次启动时丢弃。

translations.english: If LOG_REPLAY is set to 1 then the EKF2 and EKF3 state estimators will log detailed information needed for diagnosing problems with the Kalman filter. LOG_DISARMED must be set to 1 or 2 or else the log will not contain the pre-flight data required for replay testing of the EKF's. It is suggested that you also raise LOG_FILE_BUFSIZE to give more buffer space for logging and use a high quality microSD card to ensure no sensor data is lost.
translations.chinese: 设为 1 时，EKF2 和 EKF3 会记录诊断卡尔曼滤波问题所需的详细数据。LOG_DISARMED 还须设为 1 或 2，否则缺少重放测试需要的飞行前数据。官方建议增大 LOG_FILE_BUFSIZE，并使用优质 microSD 卡，避免传感器数据丢失。

translations.english: Loiter maximum pilot requested lean angle. Set to zero for 2/3 of PSC_ANGLE_MAX/ATC_ANGLE_MAX. The maximum vehicle lean angle is still limited by PSC_ANGLE_MAX/ATC_ANGLE_MAX
translations.chinese: Loiter 模式中飞手可请求的最大倾斜角。设为 0 时使用 PSC_ANGLE_MAX/ATC_ANGLE_MAX 的 2/3；飞行器实际最大倾斜角仍受 PSC_ANGLE_MAX/ATC_ANGLE_MAX 限制。

translations.english: Loiter brake start delay (in seconds)
translations.chinese: Loiter 模式开始制动前的延迟，单位为秒。

translations.english: Altitude during Landing at which vehicle slows to LAND_SPD_MS
translations.chinese: 降落时下降到此高度后，减速到 LAND_SPD_MS。

translations.english: The descent speed for the first stage of landing in m/s. If this is zero then WP_SPD_DN is used
translations.chinese: 降落第一阶段的下降速度，单位为米/秒。设为 0 时使用 WP_SPD_DN。

translations.english: Loiter maximum correction acceleration in m/s/s.  Higher values cause the copter to correct position errors more aggressively.
translations.chinese: Loiter 位置修正的最大加速度，单位为米/秒²。增大该值会更积极地修正位置偏差。

translations.english: Loiter braking acceleration in m/s/s. Higher values stop the copter more quickly when the stick is centered.
translations.chinese: Loiter 制动加速度，单位为米/秒²。增大该值可在摇杆回中后更快停止运动。

translations.english: Loiter braking jerk in m/s/s/s. Higher values will remove braking faster if the pilot moves the sticks during a braking maneuver.
translations.chinese: Loiter 制动加加速度（加速度变化率），单位为米/秒³。制动过程中若飞手再次移动摇杆，较大值会更快解除制动。

translations.english: Defines the maximum speed in m/s which the aircraft will travel horizontally while in loiter mode
translations.chinese: Loiter 模式允许的最大水平速度，单位为米/秒。

translations.english: The vertical acceleration used when pilot is controlling the altitude
translations.chinese: 飞手控制高度时使用的垂直加速度。

translations.english: The maximum vertical descending velocity the pilot may request in m/s.  If 0 PILOT_SPD_UP value is used.
translations.chinese: 飞手可请求的最大垂直下降速度，单位为米/秒。设为 0 时沿用 PILOT_SPD_UP。

translations.english: The vehicle will climb this many meters during the initial climb portion of the RTL
translations.chinese: 返航最初爬升阶段需爬升的高度增量，单位为米。

translations.english: The speed in m/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain horizontally while flying home. If this is set to zero, WP_SPD will be used instead.
translations.chinese: 返航途中的目标水平速度，单位为米/秒。设为 0 时使用 WP_SPD。

translations.english: Horizontal acceleration in m/s/s used during missions
translations.chinese: 任务飞行使用的水平加速度，单位为米/秒²。

translations.english: Vertical acceleration in m/s/s used during missions
translations.chinese: 任务飞行使用的垂直加速度，单位为米/秒²。

translations.english: Distance from a waypoint, that when crossed indicates the wp has been reached.
translations.chinese: 航点到达判定的距离阈值；进入该距离即认为到达此航点。

translations.english: Speed in m/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain while descending during a WP mission
translations.chinese: 航点任务中的目标下降速度，单位为米/秒；飞行器会尝试保持此速度。

translations.english: Speed in m/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain while climbing during a WP mission
translations.chinese: 航点任务中的目标爬升速度，单位为米/秒；飞行器会尝试保持此速度。

translations.english: Maximum airspeed demanded in automatic throttle modes. Should be set slightly less than level flight speed at THR_MAX and also at least 50% above AIRSPEED_MIN to allow for accurate TECS altitude control.
translations.chinese: 自动油门模式请求的最大空速。应略低于 THR_MAX 油门下的平飞速度，并至少比 AIRSPEED_MIN 高 50%，以保证 TECS 能准确控制高度。

translations.english: Minimum airspeed demanded in automatic throttle modes. Should be set to 20% higher than level flight stall speed.
translations.chinese: 自动油门模式请求的最小空速。官方建议比平飞失速速度高 20%。

translations.english: Flight mode for switch position 1 (910 to 1230 and above 2049)
translations.chinese: 飞行模式开关第 1 档使用的模式，对应 PWM 范围为 910～1230 或高于 2049。

translations.english: Flight mode for switch position 2 (1231 to 1360)
translations.chinese: 飞行模式开关第 2 档使用的模式，对应 PWM 范围为 1231～1360。

translations.english: Flight mode for switch position 3 (1361 to 1490)
translations.chinese: 飞行模式开关第 3 档使用的模式，对应 PWM 范围为 1361～1490。

translations.english: Flight mode for switch position 4 (1491 to 1620)
translations.chinese: 飞行模式开关第 4 档使用的模式，对应 PWM 范围为 1491～1620。

translations.english: Flight mode for switch position 5 (1621 to 1749)
translations.chinese: 飞行模式开关第 5 档使用的模式，对应 PWM 范围为 1621～1749。

translations.english: Flight mode for switch position 6 (1750 to 2049)
translations.chinese: 飞行模式开关第 6 档使用的模式，对应 PWM 范围为 1750～2049。

translations.english: RC Channel to use for flight mode control
translations.chinese: 选择用于切换飞行模式的遥控通道。

translations.english: Filter cutoff frequency for accelerometers. This can be set to a lower value to try to cope with very high vibration levels in aircraft. A value of zero means no filtering (not recommended!)
translations.chinese: 加速度计低通滤波的截止频率。降低该值可尝试缓解高振动的影响；设为 0 表示不滤波，官方不建议这样设置。

translations.english: Filter cutoff frequency for gyroscopes. This can be set to a lower value to try to cope with very high vibration levels in aircraft. A value of zero means no filtering (not recommended!)
translations.chinese: 陀螺仪低通滤波的截止频率。降低该值可尝试缓解高振动的影响；设为 0 表示不滤波，官方不建议这样设置。

translations.english: If LOG_DISARMED is set to 1 then logging will be enabled at all times including when disarmed. Logging before arming can make for very large logfiles but can help a lot when tracking down startup issues and is necessary if logging of EKF replay data is selected via the LOG_REPLAY parameter. If LOG_DISARMED is set to 2, then logging will be enabled when disarmed, but not if a USB connection is detected. This can be used to prevent unwanted data logs being generated when the vehicle is connected via USB for log downloading or parameter changes. If LOG_DISARMED is set to 3 then logging will happen while disarmed, but if the vehicle never arms then the logs using the filesystem backend will be discarded on the next boot.
translations.chinese: 控制未解锁时的日志记录。1：包括未解锁阶段在内始终记录，有助于排查启动问题，但日志可能很大；使用 LOG_REPLAY 记录 EKF 重放数据时需要飞行前记录。2：未解锁时记录，但检测到 USB 连接时不记录，可避免下载日志或改参数时产生无用日志。3：未解锁时记录，但若本次运行始终没有解锁，文件系统后端的这些日志会在下次启动时丢弃。

translations.english: If LOG_REPLAY is set to 1 then the EKF2 and EKF3 state estimators will log detailed information needed for diagnosing problems with the Kalman filter. LOG_DISARMED must be set to 1 or 2 or else the log will not contain the pre-flight data required for replay testing of the EKF's. It is suggested that you also raise LOG_FILE_BUFSIZE to give more buffer space for logging and use a high quality microSD card to ensure no sensor data is lost.
translations.chinese: 设为 1 时，EKF2 和 EKF3 会记录诊断卡尔曼滤波问题所需的详细数据。LOG_DISARMED 还须设为 1 或 2，否则缺少重放测试需要的飞行前数据。官方建议增大 LOG_FILE_BUFSIZE，并使用优质 microSD 卡，避免传感器数据丢失。

translations.english: Damping ratio for L1 control. Increase this in increments of 0.05 if you are getting overshoot in path tracking. You should not need a value below 0.7 or above 0.85.
translations.chinese: L1 航迹控制的阻尼比。如果跟踪航迹时出现超调，可每次增加 0.05 进行调整；官方说明通常不需要低于 0.7 或高于 0.85。

translations.english: The sealevel bank angle limit for a continous loiter. (Used to calculate airframe loading limits at higher altitudes). Setting to 0, will instead just scale the loiter radius directly
translations.chinese: 连续盘旋在海平面处的倾侧角限制，用于计算高海拔时的机体载荷限制。设为 0 时改为直接缩放盘旋半径。

translations.english: Period in seconds of L1 tracking loop. This parameter is the primary control for agressiveness of turns in auto mode. This needs to be larger for less responsive airframes. The default of 20 is quite conservative, but for most RC aircraft will lead to reasonable flight. For smaller more agile aircraft a value closer to 15 is appropriate, or even as low as 10 for some very agile aircraft. When tuning, change this value in small increments, as a value that is much too small (say 5 or 10 below the right value) can lead to very radical turns, and a risk of stalling.
translations.chinese: L1 航迹跟踪环路的周期，单位为秒，是影响自动模式转弯响应强弱的主要参数。响应较慢的机体需要更大的值。官方原文的默认值 20 较保守。较小且灵活的飞机可使用接近 15 的值，十分灵活的机型甚至可能使用 10。调参应小步调整；周期过小（例如比合适值低 5 或 10）可能导致过于剧烈的转弯和失速风险。

translations.english: Maximum pitch up angle commanded in modes with stabilized limits.
translations.chinese: 具有姿态稳定限制的模式中，允许请求的最大抬头俯仰角。

translations.english: Maximum pitch down angle commanded in modes with stabilized limits
translations.chinese: 具有姿态稳定限制的模式中，允许请求的最大低头俯仰角。

translations.english: The descent speed for the final stage of landing in m/s
translations.chinese: 垂直起降降落最后阶段的下降速度，单位为米/秒。

translations.english: Loiter maximum pilot requested lean angle. Set to zero for 2/3 of Q_P_ANGLE_MAX/Q_ANGLE_MAX. The maximum vehicle lean angle is still limited by Q_P_ANGLE_MAX/Q_ANGLE_MAX
translations.chinese: Loiter 模式中飞手可请求的最大倾斜角。设为 0 时使用 Q_P_ANGLE_MAX/Q_ANGLE_MAX 的 2/3；飞行器实际最大倾斜角仍受 Q_P_ANGLE_MAX/Q_ANGLE_MAX 限制。

translations.english: Loiter brake start delay (in seconds)
translations.chinese: 垂直起降 Loiter 模式开始制动前的延迟，单位为秒。

translations.english: The vertical acceleration used when pilot is controlling the altitude
translations.chinese: 垂直起降阶段由飞手控制高度时使用的垂直加速度。

translations.english: The maximum vertical velocity the pilot may request in m/s going down. If 0, uses Q_PILOT_SPD_UP value.
translations.chinese: 垂直起降阶段飞手可请求的最大垂直下降速度，单位为米/秒。设为 0 时使用 Q_PILOT_SPD_UP。

translations.english: The maximum ascending vertical velocity the pilot may request in m/s
translations.chinese: 垂直起降阶段飞手可请求的最大垂直上升速度，单位为米/秒。

translations.english: The vehicle will climb this many m during the initial climb portion of the RTL. During this time the roll will be limited to LEVEL_ROLL_LIMIT degrees.
translations.chinese: 返航最初爬升阶段需爬升的高度增量，单位为米。这一阶段横滚角限制为 LEVEL_ROLL_LIMIT 度。

translations.english: Defines the radius of the loiter circle when in RTL mode. If this is zero then WP_LOITER_RAD is used. If the radius is negative then a counter-clockwise is used. If positive then a clockwise loiter is used.
translations.chinese: RTL 模式的盘旋半径。设为 0 时使用 WP_LOITER_RAD；负值表示逆时针，正值表示顺时针。

translations.english: Damping gain for pitch control from TECS control.  Increasing may correct for oscillations in speed and height, but too much may cause additional oscillation and degraded control.
translations.chinese: TECS 俯仰控制的阻尼增益。增大该值可能缓解速度和高度振荡，但过大反而可能增加振荡、降低控制效果。

translations.english: Maximum demanded descent rate. Do not set higher than the vertical speed the aircraft can maintain at THR_MIN, TECS_PITCH_MIN, and AIRSPEED_MAX.
translations.chinese: 允许请求的最大下降率。不要高于飞机在 THR_MIN、TECS_PITCH_MIN 和 AIRSPEED_MAX 条件下能够维持的垂直下降速度。

translations.english: Damping gain for throttle demand loop. Increase to add throttle activity to dampen oscillations in speed and height.
translations.chinese: TECS 油门请求环路的阻尼增益。增大该值会增加油门调节活动，用于抑制速度和高度振荡。

translations.english: Time constant of the TECS control algorithm. Small values make faster altitude corrections but can cause overshoot and aggressive behavior.
translations.chinese: TECS 控制算法的时间常数。较小的值会加快高度修正，但也可能引起超调和过于激烈的响应。

translations.english: Maximum throttle percentage used in all modes except manual, provided THR_PASS_STAB is not set.
translations.chinese: 未启用 THR_PASS_STAB 时，除 Manual 外各模式使用的最大油门百分比。

translations.english: Minimum throttle percentage used in all modes except manual, provided THR_PASS_STAB is not set. Negative values allow reverse thrust if hardware supports it.
translations.chinese: 未启用 THR_PASS_STAB 时，除 Manual 外各模式使用的最小油门百分比。硬件支持反推时，负值允许反推。

translations.english: Maximum change in throttle percentage per second. Lower limit  based on 1 microsend of servo increase per loop. Divide SCHED_LOOP_RATE by approximately 10 to determine minimum achievable value.
translations.chinese: 每秒允许变化的最大油门百分比。可实现的最小变化率受每控制循环约 1 微秒舵机输出增量限制，可用 SCHED_LOOP_RATE 除以约 10 估算这一最小值。

translations.english: Target percentage of throttle to apply for flight in automatic throttle modes and throttle percentage that maintains AIRSPEED_CRUISE. Caution: low battery voltages at the end of flights may require higher throttle to maintain airspeed.
translations.chinese: 自动油门模式的目标油门百分比，也是维持 AIRSPEED_CRUISE 所需的油门百分比。注意：飞行末段电池电压降低时，可能需要更高油门才能保持空速。

translations.english: Defines the distance from the waypoint center, the plane will maintain during a loiter. If you set this value to a negative number then the default loiter direction will be counter-clockwise instead of clockwise.
translations.chinese: 飞机盘旋时与航点中心保持的距离。设为负数时，默认盘旋方向由顺时针改为逆时针。

translations.english: Sets the maximum distance to a waypoint for the waypoint to be considered complete. This overrides the "cross the finish line" logic that is normally used to consider a waypoint complete. For normal AUTO behaviour this parameter should be set to zero. Using a non-zero value is only recommended when it is critical that the aircraft does approach within the given radius, and should loop around until it has done so. This can cause the aircraft to loop forever if its turn radius is greater than the maximum radius set.
translations.chinese: 航点完成判定的最大距离。非零值会覆盖通常的“越过终点线即完成”逻辑，要求飞机确实进入此半径，否则继续绕回。正常 AUTO 行为应设为 0；仅在必须接近航点时使用非零值。若飞机转弯半径大于所设半径，可能一直绕圈而无法完成该航点。

translations.english: Loiter maximum correction acceleration in cm/s/s.  Higher values cause the copter to correct position errors more aggressively.
translations.chinese: Loiter 位置修正的最大加速度，单位为厘米/秒²。增大该值会更积极地修正位置偏差。

translations.english: Loiter braking acceleration in cm/s/s. Higher values stop the copter more quickly when the stick is centered.
translations.chinese: Loiter 制动加速度，单位为厘米/秒²。增大该值可在摇杆回中后更快停止运动。

translations.english: Loiter braking jerk in cm/s/s/s. Higher values will remove braking faster if the pilot moves the sticks during a braking maneuver.
translations.chinese: Loiter 制动加加速度（加速度变化率），单位为厘米/秒³。制动过程中若飞手再次移动摇杆，较大值会更快解除制动。

translations.english: Defines the maximum speed in cm/s which the aircraft will travel horizontally while in loiter mode
translations.chinese: Loiter 模式允许的最大水平速度，单位为厘米/秒。

translations.english: Defines the horizontal acceleration in cm/s/s used during missions
translations.chinese: 任务飞行使用的水平加速度，单位为厘米/秒²。

translations.english: Defines the vertical acceleration in cm/s/s used during missions
translations.chinese: 任务飞行使用的垂直加速度，单位为厘米/秒²。

translations.english: Defines the distance from a waypoint, that when crossed indicates the wp has been hit.
translations.chinese: 航点到达判定的距离阈值；进入该距离即认为到达此航点。

translations.english: Defines the speed in cm/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain while descending during a WP mission
translations.chinese: 航点任务中的目标下降速度，单位为厘米/秒；飞行器会尝试保持此速度。

translations.english: Defines the speed in cm/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain while climbing during a WP mission
translations.chinese: 航点任务中的目标爬升速度，单位为厘米/秒；飞行器会尝试保持此速度。

translations.english: Maximum airspeed demanded in automatic throttle modes. Should be set slightly less than level flight speed at THR_MAX and also at least 50% above AIRSPEED_MIN to allow for accurate TECS altitude control.
translations.chinese: 自动油门模式请求的最大空速。应略低于 THR_MAX 油门下的平飞速度，并至少比 AIRSPEED_MIN 高 50%，以保证 TECS 能准确控制高度。

translations.english: Minimum airspeed demanded in automatic throttle modes. Should be set to 20% higher than level flight stall speed.
translations.chinese: 自动油门模式请求的最小空速。官方建议比平飞失速速度高 20%。

translations.english: Flight mode for switch position 1 (910 to 1230 and above 2049)
translations.chinese: 飞行模式开关第 1 档使用的模式，对应 PWM 范围为 910～1230 或高于 2049。

translations.english: Flight mode for switch position 2 (1231 to 1360)
translations.chinese: 飞行模式开关第 2 档使用的模式，对应 PWM 范围为 1231～1360。

translations.english: Flight mode for switch position 3 (1361 to 1490)
translations.chinese: 飞行模式开关第 3 档使用的模式，对应 PWM 范围为 1361～1490。

translations.english: Flight mode for switch position 4 (1491 to 1620)
translations.chinese: 飞行模式开关第 4 档使用的模式，对应 PWM 范围为 1491～1620。

translations.english: Flight mode for switch position 5 (1621 to 1749)
translations.chinese: 飞行模式开关第 5 档使用的模式，对应 PWM 范围为 1621～1749。

translations.english: Flight mode for switch position 6 (1750 to 2049)
translations.chinese: 飞行模式开关第 6 档使用的模式，对应 PWM 范围为 1750～2049。

translations.english: RC Channel to use for flight mode control
translations.chinese: 选择用于切换飞行模式的遥控通道。

translations.english: Filter cutoff frequency for accelerometers. This can be set to a lower value to try to cope with very high vibration levels in aircraft. A value of zero means no filtering (not recommended!)
translations.chinese: 加速度计低通滤波的截止频率。降低该值可尝试缓解高振动的影响；设为 0 表示不滤波，官方不建议这样设置。

translations.english: Filter cutoff frequency for gyroscopes. This can be set to a lower value to try to cope with very high vibration levels in aircraft. A value of zero means no filtering (not recommended!)
translations.chinese: 陀螺仪低通滤波的截止频率。降低该值可尝试缓解高振动的影响；设为 0 表示不滤波，官方不建议这样设置。

translations.english: If LOG_DISARMED is set to 1 then logging will be enabled at all times including when disarmed. Logging before arming can make for very large logfiles but can help a lot when tracking down startup issues and is necessary if logging of EKF replay data is selected via the LOG_REPLAY parameter. If LOG_DISARMED is set to 2, then logging will be enabled when disarmed, but not if a USB connection is detected. This can be used to prevent unwanted data logs being generated when the vehicle is connected via USB for log downloading or parameter changes. If LOG_DISARMED is set to 3 then logging will happen while disarmed, but if the vehicle never arms then the logs using the filesystem backend will be discarded on the next boot.
translations.chinese: 控制未解锁时的日志记录。1：包括未解锁阶段在内始终记录，有助于排查启动问题，但日志可能很大；使用 LOG_REPLAY 记录 EKF 重放数据时需要飞行前记录。2：未解锁时记录，但检测到 USB 连接时不记录，可避免下载日志或改参数时产生无用日志。3：未解锁时记录，但若本次运行始终没有解锁，文件系统后端的这些日志会在下次启动时丢弃。

translations.english: If LOG_REPLAY is set to 1 then the EKF2 and EKF3 state estimators will log detailed information needed for diagnosing problems with the Kalman filter. LOG_DISARMED must be set to 1 or 2 or else the log will not contain the pre-flight data required for replay testing of the EKF's. It is suggested that you also raise LOG_FILE_BUFSIZE to give more buffer space for logging and use a high quality microSD card to ensure no sensor data is lost.
translations.chinese: 设为 1 时，EKF2 和 EKF3 会记录诊断卡尔曼滤波问题所需的详细数据。LOG_DISARMED 还须设为 1 或 2，否则缺少重放测试需要的飞行前数据。官方建议增大 LOG_FILE_BUFSIZE，并使用优质 microSD 卡，避免传感器数据丢失。

translations.english: Damping ratio for L1 control. Increase this in increments of 0.05 if you are getting overshoot in path tracking. You should not need a value below 0.7 or above 0.85.
translations.chinese: L1 航迹控制的阻尼比。如果跟踪航迹时出现超调，可每次增加 0.05 进行调整；官方说明通常不需要低于 0.7 或高于 0.85。

translations.english: The sealevel bank angle limit for a continous loiter. (Used to calculate airframe loading limits at higher altitudes). Setting to 0, will instead just scale the loiter radius directly
translations.chinese: 连续盘旋在海平面处的倾侧角限制，用于计算高海拔时的机体载荷限制。设为 0 时改为直接缩放盘旋半径。

translations.english: Period in seconds of L1 tracking loop. This parameter is the primary control for agressiveness of turns in auto mode. This needs to be larger for less responsive airframes. The default is quite conservative, but for most RC aircraft will lead to reasonable flight. For smaller more agile aircraft a value closer to 15 is appropriate, or even as low as 10 for some very agile aircraft. When tuning, change this value in small increments, as a value that is much too small (say 5 or 10 below the right value) can lead to very radical turns, and a risk of stalling.
translations.chinese: L1 航迹跟踪环路的周期，单位为秒，是影响自动模式转弯响应强弱的主要参数。响应较慢的机体需要更大的值。默认值较保守。较小且灵活的飞机可使用接近 15 的值，十分灵活的机型甚至可能使用 10。调参应小步调整；周期过小（例如比合适值低 5 或 10）可能导致过于剧烈的转弯和失速风险。

translations.english: Maximum pitch up angle commanded in modes with stabilized limits.
translations.chinese: 具有姿态稳定限制的模式中，允许请求的最大抬头俯仰角。

translations.english: Maximum pitch down angle commanded in modes with stabilized limits
translations.chinese: 具有姿态稳定限制的模式中，允许请求的最大低头俯仰角。

translations.english: The descent speed for the final stage of landing in m/s
translations.chinese: 垂直起降降落最后阶段的下降速度，单位为米/秒。

translations.english: Loiter maximum pilot requested lean angle. Set to zero for 2/3 of Q_P_ANGLE_MAX/Q_ANGLE_MAX. The maximum vehicle lean angle is still limited by Q_P_ANGLE_MAX/Q_ANGLE_MAX
translations.chinese: Loiter 模式中飞手可请求的最大倾斜角。设为 0 时使用 Q_P_ANGLE_MAX/Q_ANGLE_MAX 的 2/3；飞行器实际最大倾斜角仍受 Q_P_ANGLE_MAX/Q_ANGLE_MAX 限制。

translations.english: Loiter brake start delay (in seconds)
translations.chinese: 垂直起降 Loiter 模式开始制动前的延迟，单位为秒。

translations.english: The vertical acceleration used when pilot is controlling the altitude
translations.chinese: 垂直起降阶段由飞手控制高度时使用的垂直加速度。

translations.english: The maximum vertical velocity the pilot may request in m/s going down. If 0, uses Q_PILOT_SPD_UP value.
translations.chinese: 垂直起降阶段飞手可请求的最大垂直下降速度，单位为米/秒。设为 0 时使用 Q_PILOT_SPD_UP。

translations.english: The maximum ascending vertical velocity the pilot may request in m/s
translations.chinese: 垂直起降阶段飞手可请求的最大垂直上升速度，单位为米/秒。

translations.english: The vehicle will climb this many m during the initial climb portion of the RTL. During this time the roll will be limited to LEVEL_ROLL_LIMIT degrees.
translations.chinese: 返航最初爬升阶段需爬升的高度增量，单位为米。这一阶段横滚角限制为 LEVEL_ROLL_LIMIT 度。

translations.english: Defines the radius of the loiter circle when in RTL mode. If this is zero then WP_LOITER_RAD is used. If the radius is negative then a counter-clockwise is used. If positive then a clockwise loiter is used.
translations.chinese: RTL 模式的盘旋半径。设为 0 时使用 WP_LOITER_RAD；负值表示逆时针，正值表示顺时针。

translations.english: Damping gain for pitch control from TECS control.  Increasing may correct for oscillations in speed and height, but too much may cause additional oscillation and degraded control.
translations.chinese: TECS 俯仰控制的阻尼增益。增大该值可能缓解速度和高度振荡，但过大反而可能增加振荡、降低控制效果。

translations.english: Maximum demanded descent rate. Do not set higher than the vertical speed the aircraft can maintain at THR_MIN, TECS_PITCH_MIN, and AIRSPEED_MAX.
translations.chinese: 允许请求的最大下降率。不要高于飞机在 THR_MIN、TECS_PITCH_MIN 和 AIRSPEED_MAX 条件下能够维持的垂直下降速度。

translations.english: Damping gain for throttle demand loop. Increase to add throttle activity to dampen oscillations in speed and height.
translations.chinese: TECS 油门请求环路的阻尼增益。增大该值会增加油门调节活动，用于抑制速度和高度振荡。

translations.english: Time constant of the TECS control algorithm. Small values make faster altitude corrections but can cause overshoot and aggressive behavior.
translations.chinese: TECS 控制算法的时间常数。较小的值会加快高度修正，但也可能引起超调和过于激烈的响应。

translations.english: Maximum throttle percentage used in all modes except manual, provided THR_PASS_STAB is not set.
translations.chinese: 未启用 THR_PASS_STAB 时，除 Manual 外各模式使用的最大油门百分比。

translations.english: Minimum throttle percentage used in all modes except manual, provided THR_PASS_STAB is not set. Negative values allow reverse thrust if hardware supports it.
translations.chinese: 未启用 THR_PASS_STAB 时，除 Manual 外各模式使用的最小油门百分比。硬件支持反推时，负值允许反推。

translations.english: Maximum change in throttle percentage per second. Lower limit  based on 1 microsend of servo increase per loop. Divide SCHED_LOOP_RATE by approximately 10 to determine minimum achievable value.
translations.chinese: 每秒允许变化的最大油门百分比。可实现的最小变化率受每控制循环约 1 微秒舵机输出增量限制，可用 SCHED_LOOP_RATE 除以约 10 估算这一最小值。

translations.english: Target percentage of throttle to apply for flight in automatic throttle modes and throttle percentage that maintains AIRSPEED_CRUISE. Caution: low battery voltages at the end of flights may require higher throttle to maintain airspeed.
translations.chinese: 自动油门模式的目标油门百分比，也是维持 AIRSPEED_CRUISE 所需的油门百分比。注意：飞行末段电池电压降低时，可能需要更高油门才能保持空速。

translations.english: Defines the distance from the waypoint center, the plane will maintain during a loiter. If you set this value to a negative number then the default loiter direction will be counter-clockwise instead of clockwise.
translations.chinese: 飞机盘旋时与航点中心保持的距离。设为负数时，默认盘旋方向由顺时针改为逆时针。

translations.english: Sets the maximum distance to a waypoint for the waypoint to be considered complete. This overrides the "cross the finish line" logic that is normally used to consider a waypoint complete. For normal AUTO behaviour this parameter should be set to zero. Using a non-zero value is only recommended when it is critical that the aircraft does approach within the given radius, and should loop around until it has done so. This can cause the aircraft to loop forever if its turn radius is greater than the maximum radius set.
translations.chinese: 航点完成判定的最大距离。非零值会覆盖通常的“越过终点线即完成”逻辑，要求飞机确实进入此半径，否则继续绕回。正常 AUTO 行为应设为 0；仅在必须接近航点时使用非零值。若飞机转弯半径大于所设半径，可能一直绕圈而无法完成该航点。

translations.english: Loiter maximum correction acceleration in cm/s/s.  Higher values cause the copter to correct position errors more aggressively.
translations.chinese: Loiter 位置修正的最大加速度，单位为厘米/秒²。增大该值会更积极地修正位置偏差。

translations.english: Loiter braking acceleration in cm/s/s. Higher values stop the copter more quickly when the stick is centered.
translations.chinese: Loiter 制动加速度，单位为厘米/秒²。增大该值可在摇杆回中后更快停止运动。

translations.english: Loiter braking jerk in cm/s/s/s. Higher values will remove braking faster if the pilot moves the sticks during a braking maneuver.
translations.chinese: Loiter 制动加加速度（加速度变化率），单位为厘米/秒³。制动过程中若飞手再次移动摇杆，较大值会更快解除制动。

translations.english: Defines the maximum speed in cm/s which the aircraft will travel horizontally while in loiter mode
translations.chinese: Loiter 模式允许的最大水平速度，单位为厘米/秒。

translations.english: Defines the horizontal acceleration in cm/s/s used during missions
translations.chinese: 任务飞行使用的水平加速度，单位为厘米/秒²。

translations.english: Defines the vertical acceleration in cm/s/s used during missions
translations.chinese: 任务飞行使用的垂直加速度，单位为厘米/秒²。

translations.english: Defines the distance from a waypoint, that when crossed indicates the wp has been hit.
translations.chinese: 航点到达判定的距离阈值；进入该距离即认为到达此航点。

translations.english: Defines the speed in cm/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain while descending during a WP mission
translations.chinese: 航点任务中的目标下降速度，单位为厘米/秒；飞行器会尝试保持此速度。

translations.english: Defines the speed in cm/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain while climbing during a WP mission
translations.chinese: 航点任务中的目标爬升速度，单位为厘米/秒；飞行器会尝试保持此速度。

translations.english: Maximum airspeed demanded in automatic throttle modes. Should be set slightly less than level flight speed at THR_MAX and also at least 50% above AIRSPEED_MIN to allow for accurate TECS altitude control.
translations.chinese: 自动油门模式请求的最大空速。应略低于 THR_MAX 油门下的平飞速度，并至少比 AIRSPEED_MIN 高 50%，以保证 TECS 能准确控制高度。

translations.english: Minimum airspeed demanded in automatic throttle modes. Should be set to 20% higher than level flight stall speed.
translations.chinese: 自动油门模式请求的最小空速。官方建议比平飞失速速度高 20%。

translations.english: Flight mode for switch position 1 (910 to 1230 and above 2049)
translations.chinese: 飞行模式开关第 1 档使用的模式，对应 PWM 范围为 910～1230 或高于 2049。

translations.english: Flight mode for switch position 2 (1231 to 1360)
translations.chinese: 飞行模式开关第 2 档使用的模式，对应 PWM 范围为 1231～1360。

translations.english: Flight mode for switch position 3 (1361 to 1490)
translations.chinese: 飞行模式开关第 3 档使用的模式，对应 PWM 范围为 1361～1490。

translations.english: Flight mode for switch position 4 (1491 to 1620)
translations.chinese: 飞行模式开关第 4 档使用的模式，对应 PWM 范围为 1491～1620。

translations.english: Flight mode for switch position 5 (1621 to 1749)
translations.chinese: 飞行模式开关第 5 档使用的模式，对应 PWM 范围为 1621～1749。

translations.english: Flight mode for switch position 6 (1750 to 2049)
translations.chinese: 飞行模式开关第 6 档使用的模式，对应 PWM 范围为 1750～2049。

translations.english: RC Channel to use for flight mode control
translations.chinese: 选择用于切换飞行模式的遥控通道。

translations.english: Filter cutoff frequency for accelerometers. This can be set to a lower value to try to cope with very high vibration levels in aircraft. A value of zero means no filtering (not recommended!)
translations.chinese: 加速度计低通滤波的截止频率。降低该值可尝试缓解高振动的影响；设为 0 表示不滤波，官方不建议这样设置。

translations.english: Filter cutoff frequency for gyroscopes. This can be set to a lower value to try to cope with very high vibration levels in aircraft. A value of zero means no filtering (not recommended!)
translations.chinese: 陀螺仪低通滤波的截止频率。降低该值可尝试缓解高振动的影响；设为 0 表示不滤波，官方不建议这样设置。

Logging before arming can make for very large logfiles but can help a lot when tracking down startup issues and is necessary if logging of EKF replay data is selected via the LOG_REPLAY parameter. If LOG_DISARMED is set to 2, then logging will be enabled when disarmed, but not if a USB connection is detected. This can be used to prevent unwanted data logs being generated when the vehicle is connected via USB for log downloading or parameter changes. If LOG_DISARMED is set to 3 then logging will happen while disarmed, but if the vehicle never arms then the logs using the filesystem backend will be discarded on the next boot.

LOG_DISARMED must be set to 1 or 2 or else the log will not contain the pre-flight data required for replay testing of the EKF's. It is suggested that you also raise LOG_FILE_BUFSIZE to give more buffer space for logging and use a high quality microSD card to ensure no sensor data is lost.
translations.chinese: 设为 1 时，EKF2 和 EKF3 会记录诊断卡尔曼滤波问题所需的详细数据。LOG_DISARMED 还须设为 1 或 2，否则缺少重放测试需要的飞行前数据。官方建议增大 LOG_FILE_BUFSIZE，并使用优质 microSD 卡，避免传感器数据丢失。

translations.chinese: L1 航迹控制的阻尼比。如果跟踪航迹时出现超调，可每次增加 0.05 进行调整；官方说明通常不需要低于 0.7 或高于 0.85。

translations.chinese: 连续盘旋在海平面处的倾侧角限制，用于计算高海拔时的机体载荷限制。设为 0 时改为直接缩放盘旋半径。

The default is quite conservative, but for most RC aircraft will lead to reasonable flight. For smaller more agile aircraft a value closer to 15 is appropriate, or even as low as 10 for some very agile aircraft. When tuning, change this value in small increments, as a value that is much too small (say 5 or 10 below the right value) can lead to very radical turns, and a risk of stalling.

translations.english: Maximum pitch up angle commanded in modes with stabilized limits.
translations.chinese: 具有姿态稳定限制的模式中，允许请求的最大抬头俯仰角。

translations.english: Maximum pitch down angle commanded in modes with stabilized limits
translations.chinese: 具有姿态稳定限制的模式中，允许请求的最大低头俯仰角。

translations.english: The descent speed for the final stage of landing in m/s
translations.chinese: 垂直起降降落最后阶段的下降速度，单位为米/秒。

translations.english: Loiter maximum pilot requested lean angle. Set to zero for 2/3 of Q_P_ANGLE_MAX/Q_A_ANGLE_MAX. The maximum vehicle lean angle is still limited by Q_P_ANGLE_MAX/Q_A_ANGLE_MAX
translations.chinese: Loiter 模式中飞手可请求的最大倾斜角。设为 0 时使用 Q_P_ANGLE_MAX/Q_A_ANGLE_MAX 的 2/3；飞行器实际最大倾斜角仍受 Q_P_ANGLE_MAX/Q_A_ANGLE_MAX 限制。

translations.english: Loiter brake start delay (in seconds)
translations.chinese: 垂直起降 Loiter 模式开始制动前的延迟，单位为秒。

translations.english: The vertical acceleration used when pilot is controlling the altitude
translations.chinese: 垂直起降阶段由飞手控制高度时使用的垂直加速度。

translations.english: The maximum vertical velocity the pilot may request in m/s going down. If 0, uses Q_PILOT_SPD_UP value.
translations.chinese: 垂直起降阶段飞手可请求的最大垂直下降速度，单位为米/秒。设为 0 时使用 Q_PILOT_SPD_UP。

translations.english: The maximum ascending vertical velocity the pilot may request in m/s
translations.chinese: 垂直起降阶段飞手可请求的最大垂直上升速度，单位为米/秒。

translations.english: The vehicle will climb this many m during the initial climb portion of the RTL. During this time the roll will be limited to LEVEL_ROLL_LIMIT degrees.
translations.chinese: 返航最初爬升阶段需爬升的高度增量，单位为米。这一阶段横滚角限制为 LEVEL_ROLL_LIMIT 度。

translations.english: Defines the radius of the loiter circle when in RTL mode. If this is zero then WP_LOITER_RAD is used. If the radius is negative then a counter-clockwise is used. If positive then a clockwise loiter is used. For quadplanes with Q_RTL_MODE set to 1 (Enabled), this value is used to set the minimum radius at which the plane will transition from fixed-wing to VTOL mode for landing.
translations.chinese: RTL 模式的盘旋半径。设为 0 时使用 WP_LOITER_RAD；负值表示逆时针，正值表示顺时针。对于 Q_RTL_MODE=1 的 QuadPlane，此值还设置从固定翼转换为 VTOL 降落的最小半径。

translations.english: Damping gain for pitch control from TECS control.  Increasing may correct for oscillations in speed and height, but too much may cause additional oscillation and degraded control.
translations.chinese: TECS 俯仰控制的阻尼增益。增大该值可能缓解速度和高度振荡，但过大反而可能增加振荡、降低控制效果。

translations.english: Maximum demanded descent rate. Do not set higher than the vertical speed the aircraft can maintain at THR_MIN, TECS_PITCH_MIN, and AIRSPEED_MAX.
translations.chinese: 允许请求的最大下降率。不要高于飞机在 THR_MIN、TECS_PITCH_MIN 和 AIRSPEED_MAX 条件下能够维持的垂直下降速度。

translations.english: Damping gain for throttle demand loop. Increase to add throttle activity to dampen oscillations in speed and height.
translations.chinese: TECS 油门请求环路的阻尼增益。增大该值会增加油门调节活动，用于抑制速度和高度振荡。

translations.english: Time constant of the TECS control algorithm. Small values make faster altitude corrections but can cause overshoot and aggressive behavior.
translations.chinese: TECS 控制算法的时间常数。较小的值会加快高度修正，但也可能引起超调和过于激烈的响应。

translations.english: Maximum throttle percentage used in all modes except manual, provided THR_PASS_STAB is not set.
translations.chinese: 未启用 THR_PASS_STAB 时，除 Manual 外各模式使用的最大油门百分比。

translations.english: Minimum throttle percentage used in all modes except manual, provided THR_PASS_STAB is not set. Negative values allow reverse thrust if hardware supports it.
translations.chinese: 未启用 THR_PASS_STAB 时，除 Manual 外各模式使用的最小油门百分比。硬件支持反推时，负值允许反推。

translations.english: Maximum change in throttle percentage per second. Lower limit  based on 1 microsend of servo increase per loop. Divide SCHED_LOOP_RATE by approximately 10 to determine minimum achievable value.
translations.chinese: 每秒允许变化的最大油门百分比。可实现的最小变化率受每控制循环约 1 微秒舵机输出增量限制，可用 SCHED_LOOP_RATE 除以约 10 估算这一最小值。

translations.english: Target percentage of throttle to apply for flight in automatic throttle modes and throttle percentage that maintains AIRSPEED_CRUISE. Caution: low battery voltages at the end of flights may require higher throttle to maintain airspeed.
translations.chinese: 自动油门模式的目标油门百分比，也是维持 AIRSPEED_CRUISE 所需的油门百分比。注意：飞行末段电池电压降低时，可能需要更高油门才能保持空速。

translations.english: Defines the distance from the waypoint center, the plane will maintain during a loiter. If you set this value to a negative number then the default loiter direction will be counter-clockwise instead of clockwise. If this value is too close to zero, the achieved loiter radius will be determined by ROLL_LIMIT_DEG.
translations.chinese: 飞机盘旋时与航点中心保持的距离。设为负数时，默认盘旋方向由顺时针改为逆时针。若数值过于接近 0，实际盘旋半径将由 ROLL_LIMIT_DEG 决定。

translations.english: Sets the maximum distance to a waypoint for the waypoint to be considered complete. This overrides the "cross the finish line" logic that is normally used to consider a waypoint complete. For normal AUTO behaviour this parameter should be set to zero. Using a non-zero value is only recommended when it is critical that the aircraft does approach within the given radius, and should loop around until it has done so. This can cause the aircraft to loop forever if its turn radius is greater than the maximum radius set.
translations.chinese: 航点完成判定的最大距离。非零值会覆盖通常的“越过终点线即完成”逻辑，要求飞机确实进入此半径，否则继续绕回。正常 AUTO 行为应设为 0；仅在必须接近航点时使用非零值。若飞机转弯半径大于所设半径，可能一直绕圈而无法完成该航点。

translations.english: Loiter maximum correction acceleration in m/s/s.  Higher values cause the copter to correct position errors more aggressively.
translations.chinese: Loiter 位置修正的最大加速度，单位为米/秒²。增大该值会更积极地修正位置偏差。

translations.english: Loiter braking acceleration in m/s/s. Higher values stop the copter more quickly when the stick is centered.
translations.chinese: Loiter 制动加速度，单位为米/秒²。增大该值可在摇杆回中后更快停止运动。

translations.english: Loiter braking jerk in m/s/s/s. Higher values will remove braking faster if the pilot moves the sticks during a braking maneuver.
translations.chinese: Loiter 制动加加速度（加速度变化率），单位为米/秒³。制动过程中若飞手再次移动摇杆，较大值会更快解除制动。

translations.english: Defines the maximum speed in m/s which the aircraft will travel horizontally while in loiter mode
translations.chinese: Loiter 模式允许的最大水平速度，单位为米/秒。

translations.english: Horizontal acceleration in m/s/s used during missions
translations.chinese: 任务飞行使用的水平加速度，单位为米/秒²。

translations.english: Vertical acceleration in m/s/s used during missions
translations.chinese: 任务飞行使用的垂直加速度，单位为米/秒²。

translations.english: Distance from a waypoint, that when crossed indicates the wp has been reached.
translations.chinese: 航点到达判定的距离阈值；进入该距离即认为到达此航点。

translations.english: Speed in m/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain while descending during a WP mission
translations.chinese: 航点任务中的目标下降速度，单位为米/秒；飞行器会尝试保持此速度。

translations.english: Speed in m/s which the aircraft will attempt to maintain while climbing during a WP mission
translations.chinese: 航点任务中的目标爬升速度，单位为米/秒；飞行器会尝试保持此速度。

translations.english: The altitude at which we should switch to Q_LAND_FINAL_SPD descent rate
translations.chinese: 垂直起降降落中，切换到 Q_LAND_FINAL_SPD 下降速度的高度。

translations.english: Mixing of pitch and throttle correction for height and airspeed errors. Pitch controls altitude and throttle controls airspeed if set to 0. Pitch controls airspeed and throttle controls altitude if set to 2 (good for gliders). Blended if set to 1.
translations.chinese: 设置俯仰与油门对高度误差和空速误差的分工权重。0：俯仰控制高度、油门控制空速。2：俯仰控制空速、油门控制高度，适合滑翔机。1：两者混合。

translations.chinese: 控制板累计启动次数。

translations.chinese: 固件记录的累计飞行时间（秒）。

translations.english: Bitmap of what Logger backend types to enable. Block-based logging is available on SITL and boards with dataflash chips. Multiple backends can be selected.
translations.chinese: 用位掩码选择要启用的日志后端，可同时选择多个。SITL（软件在环仿真）和带有 DataFlash 芯片的飞控板支持块存储日志后端。

translations.english: When set, the current log file is closed when the vehicle is disarmed.  If LOG_DISARMED is set then a fresh log will be opened. Applies to the File and Block logging backends.
translations.chinese: 启用后，飞行器从解锁转为上锁时会关闭当前日志文件。若已启用 LOG_DISARMED，则另开一份日志。适用于文件和块存储日志后端。

translations.english: Maximum amount of memory to allocate to AP_Logger-over-mavlink
translations.chinese: MAVLink 日志后端可分配给缓冲区的最大内存。

translations.english: This controls the amount of time before failing writes to a log file cause the file to be closed and logging stopped.
translations.chinese: 日志文件持续写入失败时允许等待的时间，单位为秒。超过此时间，文件后端会关闭当前文件并停止记录。

translations.english: This sets the maximum rate that streaming log messages will be logged to the file backend. A value of zero means that rate limiting is disabled.
translations.chinese: 流式日志消息写入文件后端的最高频率。设为 0 时，关闭此项限速。

translations.english: This sets the maximum rate that streaming log messages will be logged to the mavlink backend. A value of zero means that rate limiting is disabled.
translations.chinese: 通过 MAVLink 日志后端记录流式日志消息的最高频率。设为 0 时，关闭此项限速。

translations.english: This sets the maximum rate that streaming log messages will be logged to the block backend. A value of zero means that rate limiting is disabled.
translations.chinese: 流式日志消息写入块存储后端的最高频率。设为 0 时，关闭此项限速。

translations.english: This sets the maximum rate that streaming log messages will be logged to any backend when disarmed. A value of zero means that the normal backend rate limit is applied.
translations.chinese: 飞行器处于上锁状态时，各日志后端记录流式日志消息的最高频率。设为 0 时，沿用各后端通常的限速设置。

translations.english: If LOG_DISARMED is set to 1 then logging will be enabled at all times including when disarmed. Logging before arming can make for very large logfiles but can help a lot when tracking down startup issues and is necessary if logging of EKF replay data is selected via the LOG_REPLAY parameter. If LOG_DISARMED is set to 2, then logging will be enabled when disarmed, but not if a USB connection is detected. This can be used to prevent unwanted data logs being generated when the vehicle is connected via USB for log downloading or parameter changes. If LOG_DISARMED is set to 3 then logging will happen while disarmed, but if the vehicle never arms then the logs using the filesystem backend will be discarded on the next boot.
translations.chinese: 控制未解锁时的日志记录。设为 1 时始终记录，包括未解锁阶段。解锁前的记录有助于排查启动问题，但日志文件可能很大。通过 LOG_REPLAY 启用 EKF 重放数据记录时，也需要这段解锁前的日志。设为 2 时也记录未解锁阶段，检测到 USB 连接时除外，以免下载日志或修改参数时生成多余日志。设为 3 时记录未解锁阶段。若本次运行始终未解锁，文件系统后端会在下次启动时丢弃本次日志。

translations.english: If LOG_REPLAY is set to 1 then the EKF2 and EKF3 state estimators will log detailed information needed for diagnosing problems with the Kalman filter. LOG_DISARMED must be set to 1 or 2 or else the log will not contain the pre-flight data required for replay testing of the EKF's. It is suggested that you also raise LOG_FILE_BUFSIZE to give more buffer space for logging and use a high quality microSD card to ensure no sensor data is lost.
translations.chinese: 设为 1 时，EKF2 和 EKF3 状态估计器会记录诊断卡尔曼滤波问题所需的详细数据。要在日志中保留重放测试所需的飞行前数据，LOG_DISARMED 必须设为 1 或 2。ArduPilot 原说明建议增大 LOG_FILE_BUFSIZE 以增加日志缓冲空间，并使用优质 microSD 卡，以免丢失传感器数据。

translations.chinese: 按位组合 OSD 显示选项。例如，位 1 用于反转风向箭头的显示方向。

translations.english: This sets options that change the display
translations.chinese: 按位组合 OSD 显示选项。例如，位 1 用于反转风向箭头的显示方向。

translations.english: Sets the units to use in displaying items
translations.chinese: 选择 OSD 显示项目所用的单位制。0 为公制，1 为英制，2 为国际单位制（SI），3 为航空单位制。

translations.english: Set level at which RSSI item will flash (in positive % or negative dBm values as applicable). 30% or -100dBm are defaults.
translations.chinese: 设置 OSD 的 RSSI 项目闪烁阈值。按所用的显示方式填写正百分比或负 dBm 值，默认分别为 30% 和 -100 dBm。

translations.english: Set level at which NSAT item will flash
translations.chinese: 当卫星数低于此阈值时，OSD 的 NSAT 项目闪烁。

translations.english: Set level at which BAT_VOLT item will flash
translations.chinese: 当电池电压低于此阈值时，OSD 的 BAT_VOLT 项目闪烁。

translations.english: Set level below which TER_HGT item will flash. -1 disables.
translations.chinese: 当距地形的高度低于此阈值时，OSD 的 TER_HGT 项目闪烁。阈值单位为米，设为 -1 可关闭此闪烁提示。

translations.english: Set level at which AVGCELLV item will flash
translations.chinese: 当单节平均电压低于此阈值时，OSD 的 AVGCELLV 项目闪烁。

translations.english: Set level at which RESTVOLT item will flash
translations.chinese: 当估算的电池静置电压低于此阈值时，OSD 的 RESTVOLT 项目闪烁。

translations.english: Set level at which ACRVOLT item will flash
translations.chinese: 当估算的单节平均静置电压低于此阈值时，OSD 的 ACRVOLT 项目闪烁。

translations.english: Set level at which RC_LQ item will flash (%)
translations.chinese: 当遥控链路质量低于此阈值时，OSD 的 RC_LQ 项目闪烁。阈值以百分比表示。

translations.english: Set level at which RC_SNR item will flash (in db)
translations.chinese: 当遥控链路信噪比低于此阈值时，OSD 的 RC_SNR 项目闪烁。阈值单位为 dB。

translations.english: Screen to be shown on Arm event. Zero to disable the feature.
translations.chinese: 飞控由上锁转为解锁时，切换到所选且已启用的 OSD 画面。设为 0 时，不因解锁事件切换画面。

translations.english: Screen to be shown on disarm event. Zero to disable the feature.
translations.chinese: 飞控由解锁转为上锁时，切换到所选且已启用的 OSD 画面。设为 0 时，不因上锁事件切换画面。

translations.english: Screen to be shown on failsafe event. Zero to disable the feature.
translations.chinese: 遥控或电池失效保护开始时，切换到所选且已启用的 OSD 画面。设为 0 时，不指定进入保护时要切换到的画面。

translations.english: Used for average cell voltage display. -1 disables, 0 uses cell count autodetection for well charged LIPO/LIION batteries at connection, other values manually select cell count used.
translations.chinese: 仅用于计算 OSD 显示的平均单体电压和平均单体静置电压。设为 -1 时，这两项不显示电压数值。设为 0 时自动估算电芯数，接入时电量较低的锂聚合物或锂离子电池可能估算不准。正整数表示手动指定的电芯数。

translations.chinese: 控制第 1 个 OSD 画面是否显示风速和相对风向。Rover 若装有风向标，则显示由风向标测得的表观风速和风向。

translations.english: Waypoint speed default

translations.english: Number of times board has been booted

translations.english: Total time autopilot has run

translations.english: OSD type. TXONLY makes the OSD parameter selection available to other modules even if there is no native OSD support on the board, for instance CRSF.
translations.chinese: 选择 OSD 类型。TXONLY 可在没有原生 OSD 的板卡上，让其他模块（例如 CRSF）使用 OSD 参数选择。

translations.english: This sets the channel used to switch different OSD screens.
translations.chinese: 设置用于切换不同 OSD 屏幕的遥控通道。

translations.english: This sets the method used to switch different OSD screens.
translations.chinese: 设置切换 OSD 屏幕的方法。

translations.english: Debounce time in ms for stick commanded parameter navigation.
translations.chinese: 设置用摇杆操作参数导航时的按键去抖时间，单位为毫秒。

translations.english: OSD type 2. TXONLY makes the OSD parameter selection available to other modules even if there is no native OSD support on the board, for instance CRSF.
translations.chinese: 选择第二套 OSD 类型。TXONLY 可在没有原生 OSD 的板卡上，让其他模块（例如 CRSF）使用 OSD 参数选择。

translations.english: This is the speed in Hertz that your ESCs will receive updates
translations.chinese: 设置发送给电调的更新速度，单位为 Hz。

translations.english: Timeout after which RC overrides will no longer be used, and RC input will resume, 0 will disable RC overrides, -1 will never timeout, and continue using overrides until they are disabled
translations.chinese: 设置 RC 覆盖的超时时间。超时后恢复使用 RC 输入；0 表示禁用 RC 覆盖；-1 表示永不超时，直到禁用覆盖。

translations.english: RC input options
translations.chinese: RC 输入选项位掩码。

translations.english: Bitmask of enabled RC protocols. Allows narrowing the protocol detection to only specific types of RC receivers which can avoid issues with incorrect detection. Set to 1 to enable all protocols.
translations.chinese: 启用的 RC 协议位掩码。可将协议检测限定为特定接收机类型，以避免误识别；设为 1 可启用所有协议。

translations.english: RC failsafe will trigger this many seconds after loss of RC
translations.chinese: 设置 RC 丢失后触发 RC 失控保护前的等待时间，单位为秒。

translations.english: RC minimum PWM pulse width in microseconds. Typically 1000 is lower limit, 1500 is neutral and 2000 is upper limit.
translations.chinese: 设置 RC 通道 1 的最小 PWM 脉宽，单位为微秒。通常下限为 1000，中位为 1500，上限为 2000。

translations.english: RC trim (neutral) PWM pulse width in microseconds. Typically 1000 is lower limit, 1500 is neutral and 2000 is upper limit.
translations.chinese: 设置 RC 通道 1 的中位（微调）PWM 脉宽，单位为微秒。通常下限为 1000，中位为 1500，上限为 2000。

translations.english: RC maximum PWM pulse width in microseconds. Typically 1000 is lower limit, 1500 is neutral and 2000 is upper limit.
translations.chinese: 设置 RC 通道 1 的最大 PWM 脉宽，单位为微秒。通常下限为 1000，中位为 1500，上限为 2000。

translations.english: Reverse channel input. Set to 0 for normal operation. Set to 1 to reverse this input channel.
translations.chinese: 设置 RC 通道 1 是否反向。0 为正常，1 为反向。

translations.english: PWM dead zone in microseconds around trim or bottom
translations.chinese: 设置 RC 通道 1 在微调值或底端附近的 PWM 死区，单位为微秒。

translations.english: Function assigned to this RC channel
translations.chinese: 设置分配给 RC 通道 1 的输入功能。

translations.english: The baud rate used on the USB console. Most stm32-based boards can support rates of up to 1500. If you setup a rate you cannot support and then can't connect to your board you should load a firmware from a different vehicle type. That will reset all your parameters to defaults.
translations.chinese: 设置 USB 控制台使用的波特率。大多数基于 STM32 的板卡最高支持 1500 kBaud；若设置了板卡不支持的速率导致无法连接，应刷写其他机型固件以恢复默认参数。

translations.english: Control over UART options. The InvertRX option controls invert of the receive pin. The InvertTX option controls invert of the transmit pin. The HalfDuplex option controls half-duplex (onewire) mode, where both transmit and receive is done on the transmit wire. The Swap option allows the RX and TX pins to be swapped on STM32F7 based boards.  NOTE that two bits have moved from this parameter into MAVn_OPTIONS!
translations.chinese: 设置 Serial1 端口的 UART 选项。可反转 RX/TX、启用半双工、交换 RX/TX，以及配置上下拉、DMA、FIFO 和流速率行为；其中部分选项在 4.7 以后已移至 MAVn_OPTIONS。

translations.english: Ensure this battery is configured with `BATT*_MONITOR=29`.
translations.chinese: 设置分配给此电池的索引。请确保该电池配置为 BATT*_MONITOR=29。

translations.english: Controls enabling monitoring of the battery's voltage and current
translations.chinese: 控制是否监测电池电压和电流，以及所使用的监测类型。

translations.english: Capacity of the battery in mAh when full
translations.chinese: 设置电池充满时的容量，单位为 mAh。

translations.english: Battery serial number, automatically filled in for SMBus batteries, otherwise will be -1. With DroneCan it is the battery_id.
translations.chinese: 电池序列号。SMBus 电池会自动填写；其他电池为 -1。使用 DroneCAN 时，此值为 battery_id。

translations.english: This is the timeout in seconds before a low voltage event will be triggered. For aircraft with low C batteries it may be necessary to raise this in order to cope with low voltage on long takeoffs. A value of zero disables low voltage errors.
translations.chinese: 设置触发低电压事件前的持续时间，单位为秒。低 C 值电池在长时间起飞时可能需要增大此值；设为 0 可禁用低电压错误。

translations.english: Voltage type used for detection of low voltage event
translations.chinese: 选择检测低电压事件时使用的电压类型。

translations.english: Battery voltage that triggers a low battery failsafe. Set to 0 to disable. If the battery voltage drops below this voltage continuously for more then the period specified by the BATT_LOW_TIMER parameter then the vehicle will perform the failsafe specified by the BATT_FS_LOW_ACT parameter.
translations.chinese: 设置触发低电量失控保护的电池电压。设为 0 可禁用；电压低于该值并持续 BATT_LOW_TIMER 指定时间后，执行 BATT_FS_LOW_ACT 指定的失控保护动作。

translations.english: Battery capacity at which the low battery failsafe is triggered. Set to 0 to disable battery remaining failsafe. If the battery capacity drops below this level the vehicle will perform the failsafe specified by the BATT_FS_LOW_ACT parameter.
translations.chinese: 设置触发低电量失控保护的剩余容量。设为 0 可禁用；容量低于该值后，执行 BATT_FS_LOW_ACT 指定的失控保护动作。

translations.english: Battery voltage that triggers a critical battery failsafe. Set to 0 to disable. If the battery voltage drops below this voltage continuously for more then the period specified by the BATT_LOW_TIMER parameter then the vehicle will perform the failsafe specified by the BATT_FS_CRT_ACT parameter.
translations.chinese: 设置触发严重低电量失控保护的电池电压。设为 0 可禁用；电压低于该值并持续 BATT_LOW_TIMER 指定时间后，执行 BATT_FS_CRT_ACT 指定的失控保护动作。

translations.english: Battery capacity at which the critical battery failsafe is triggered. Set to 0 to disable battery remaining failsafe. If the battery capacity drops below this level the vehicle will perform the failsafe specified by the BATT_FS_CRT_ACT parameter.
translations.chinese: 设置触发严重低电量失控保护的剩余容量。设为 0 可禁用；容量低于该值后，执行 BATT_FS_CRT_ACT 指定的失控保护动作。

translations.english: What action the vehicle should perform if it hits a low battery failsafe
translations.chinese: 设置触发低电量失控保护时飞行器应执行的动作。

translations.english: What action the vehicle should perform if it hits a critical battery failsafe
translations.chinese: 设置触发严重低电量失控保护时飞行器应执行的动作。

translations.english: Battery voltage level which is required to arm the aircraft. Set to 0 to allow arming at any voltage.
translations.chinese: 达到此电池电压后才满足解锁的电压条件。设为 0 时跳过此项电压检查。

translations.english: Battery capacity remaining which is required to arm the aircraft. Set to 0 to allow arming at any capacity. Note that execept for smart batteries rebooting the vehicle will always reset the remaining capacity estimate, which can lead to this check not providing sufficent protection, it is recommended to always use this in conjunction with the BATT_ARM_VOLT parameter.
translations.chinese: 设置允许解锁所需的最低剩余容量。设为 0 可允许任意容量下解锁。智能电池以外的电池重启飞行器后会重置剩余容量估计，建议与 BATT_ARM_VOLT 一起使用。

translations.english: This sets options to change the behaviour of the battery monitor
translations.chinese: 设置用于改变电池监测器行为的选项。

translations.english: ESC Telemetry Index to write voltage, current, consumption and temperature data to. Use 0 to disable.
translations.chinese: 设置写入电压、电流、耗电量和温度数据的电调遥测索引。设为 0 可禁用。

translations.english: 0: sum of remaining battery monitors, If none 0 sum of specified monitors. Current will be summed and voltages averaged.
translations.chinese: 设置参与电池汇总的监测器位掩码。为 0 时汇总其余电池监测器；若未选中任何监测器，则按指定监测器汇总。电流求和，电压取平均值。

translations.english: Multiplier applied to all current related reports to allow for adjustment if no UAVCAN param access or current splitting applications
translations.chinese: 设置应用于所有电流相关报告的倍率，以便在无法访问 UAVCAN 参数或需要分流时校正电流。

translations.english: Maximum voltage of battery. Provides scaling of current versus voltage
translations.chinese: 设置电池最大电压，用于按电压缩放电流。

translations.english: If 0 all connected ESCs will be used. If non-zero, only those selected in will be used.
translations.chinese: 设置电调位掩码。为 0 时使用所有已连接电调；非 0 时仅使用选中的电调。

translations.english: INA3221 channel to return data for
translations.chinese: 设置 INA3221 返回数据的通道。

translations.english: Controls whether failsafe will be invoked (and what action to take) when connection with Ground station is lost for at least 5 seconds. See FS_OPTIONS param for additional actions, or for cases allowing Mission continuation, when GCS failsafe is enabled.
translations.chinese: 设置地面站连接至少丢失 5 秒时是否触发地面站失控保护，以及触发的动作。启用后可结合 FS_OPTIONS 设置继续任务等附加行为。

translations.english: The throttle failsafe allows you to configure a software failsafe activated by a setting on the throttle input channel
translations.chinese: 设置是否启用由油门输入通道触发的软件油门失控保护，以及触发时的动作。

translations.english: The PWM level in microseconds on channel 3 below which throttle failsafe triggers
translations.chinese: 设置通道 3 触发油门失控保护的 PWM 阈值（微秒）。输入低于该值时触发。

translations.english: Controls the action that will be taken when an EKF failsafe is invoked
translations.chinese: 设置 EKF 失控保护触发时采取的动作。

translations.english: Allows setting the maximum acceptable compass, velocity, position and height variances. Used in arming check and EKF failsafe.
translations.chinese: 设置罗盘、速度、位置和高度方差的最大允许值，用于解锁检查和 EKF 失控保护。

translations.english: This enables automatic crash checking. When enabled the motors will disarm if a crash is detected.
translations.chinese: 启用自动坠机检查。启用后检测到坠机时会解除电机解锁。

translations.english: This enables the vibration failsafe which will use modified altitude estimation and control during high vibrations
translations.chinese: 启用振动失控保护。高振动时将使用修改后的高度估计和控制。

translations.english: Bitmask of additional options for battery, radio, & GCS failsafes. 0 (default) disables all options.
translations.chinese: 电池、遥控和地面站失控保护的附加选项位掩码。默认值 0 表示禁用所有选项。

translations.english: Timeout before triggering the GCS failsafe
translations.chinese: 设置触发地面站失控保护前的超时时间，单位为秒。

translations.english: Failsafe action taken immediately as deadreckoning starts. Deadreckoning starts when EKF loses position and velocity source and relies only on wind estimates
translations.chinese: 设置开始死推算时立即采取的失控保护动作。死推算在 EKF 丢失位置和速度源后开始，仅依靠风估计。

translations.english: DeadReckoning is available for this many seconds after losing position and/or velocity source.  After this timeout elapses the EKF failsafe will trigger in modes requiring a position estimate
translations.chinese: 设置丢失位置和/或速度源后可进行死推算的持续时间，单位为秒。超时后，在需要位置估计的模式下将触发 EKF 失控保护。

translations.english: EKF Failsafe filter cutoff frequency. EKF variances are filtered using this value to avoid spurious failsafes from transient high variances. A higher value means the failsafe is more likely to trigger.
translations.chinese: 设置 EKF 失控保护滤波器的截止频率，单位为 Hz。EKF 方差使用该值滤波以避免瞬态高方差造成误触发；值越高，越容易触发失控保护。

translations.english: Accelerometer error threshold used to determine inconsistent accelerometers. Compares this error range to other accelerometers to detect a hardware or calibration error. Lower value means tighter check and harder to pass arming check. Not all accelerometers are created equal.
translations.chinese: 设置用于判定加速度计不一致的误差阈值。该范围与其他加速度计比较，以检测硬件或校准错误；值越低，检查越严格。

translations.english: Allow arm/disarm by rudder input. When enabled arming can be done with right rudder, disarming with left rudder. Rudder arming only works with throttle at zero +- deadzone (RCx_DZ). Depending on vehicle type, arming in certain modes is prevented. See the wiki for each vehicle. Caution is recommended when arming if it is allowed in an auto-throttle mode!
translations.chinese: 设置是否允许使用方向舵解锁/锁定。启用后，右方向舵可解锁，左方向舵可锁定；油门必须处于零位死区内。

translations.english: Bitmask of mission items that are required to be planned in order to arm the aircraft
translations.chinese: 设置解锁前必须在任务中规划的任务项位掩码。

translations.english: Options that can be applied to change arming behaviour
translations.chinese: 设置用于改变解锁行为的选项。

translations.english: Compass magnetic field strength error threshold vs earth magnetic model.  X and y axis are compared using this threhold, Z axis uses 2x this threshold.  0 to disable check
translations.chinese: 设置相对于地磁模型的罗盘磁场强度误差阈值。X/Y 轴使用该阈值比较，Z 轴使用其 2 倍；设为 0 可禁用检查。

translations.english: Require that the vehicle have an absolute position before it arms.  This can help ensure that the vehicle can Return To Launch.
translations.chinese: 设置是否要求飞行器在解锁前具有绝对位置，以帮助确保可以返航。

translations.english: Checks to skip prior to arming motor. This is a bitmask of checks before allowing arming that will be skipped. For most users it is recommended to leave this at the default of 0 (no checks skipped). In extreme circumstances, a value of -1 can be used to skip all non-mandatory current and future checks.
translations.chinese: 设置解锁前要跳过的检查位掩码。通常建议保持默认值 0；极端情况下 -1 会跳过所有当前和未来的非强制检查。

translations.english: Function assigned to this servo. Setting this to Disabled(0) will setup this output for control by auto missions or MAVLink servo set commands. any other value will enable the corresponding function
translations.chinese: 设置分配给此舵机输出的功能。设为 Disabled（0）时，该输出可由自动任务或 MAVLink 舵机设置命令控制；其他值将启用对应功能。

translations.english: Trim PWM pulse width in microseconds. Typically 1000 is lower limit, 1500 is neutral and 2000 is upper limit.
translations.chinese: 设置微调 PWM 脉宽，单位为微秒。通常下限为 1000，中位为 1500，上限为 2000。

translations.english: minimum PWM pulse width in microseconds. Typically 1000 is lower limit, 1500 is neutral and 2000 is upper limit.
translations.chinese: 设置最小 PWM 脉宽，单位为微秒。通常下限为 1000，中位为 1500，上限为 2000。

translations.english: maximum PWM pulse width in microseconds. Typically 1000 is lower limit, 1500 is neutral and 2000 is upper limit.
translations.chinese: 设置最大 PWM 脉宽，单位为微秒。通常下限为 1000，中位为 1500，上限为 2000。

translations.english: Reverse servo operation. Set to 0 for normal operation. Set to 1 to reverse this output channel.
translations.chinese: 设置舵机输出是否反向。0 为正常，1 为反向。
