translations.chinese: 设置最小 PWM 脉宽，单位为微秒。通常下限为 1000，中位为 1500，上限为 2000。

translations.english: maximum PWM pulse width in microseconds. Typically 1000 is lower limit, 1500 is neutral and 2000 is upper limit.
translations.chinese: 设置最大 PWM 脉宽，单位为微秒。通常下限为 1000，中位为 1500，上限为 2000。

translations.english: Reverse servo operation. Set to 0 for normal operation. Set to 1 to reverse this output channel.
translations.chinese: 设置舵机输出是否反向。0 为正常，1 为反向。

translations.english: This allows for up to 32 outputs, enabling parameters for outputs above 16
translations.chinese: 启用 17 至 31 号输出，从而支持最多 32 路输出并启用 16 号以上输出的参数。

translations.english: Bitmask of outputs which will be available as GPIOs. Any output with either the function set to -1 or with the corresponding bit set in this mask will be available for use as a GPIO pin
translations.chinese: 设置可用作 GPIO 的输出位掩码。功能设为 -1 或在此掩码中置位的输出可用作 GPIO 引脚。

translations.english: Default output rate in Hz for all PWM outputs.
translations.chinese: 设置所有 PWM 输出的默认输出速率，单位为 Hz。

translations.english: Bitmask of scaled passthru output channels which will be set to their trim value during rc failsafe instead of holding their last position before failsafe.
translations.chinese: 设置 RC 失控保护期间要置为微调值的缩放直通输出通道位掩码；未选中的通道保持失控保护前的最后位置。

translations.english: This sets the SBUS output frame rate in Hz.
translations.chinese: 设置 SBUS 输出帧率，单位为 Hz。

translations.english: If set to 1 this auto-enables BLHeli pass-thru support for all multicopter motors
translations.chinese: 设为 1 时，自动为所有多旋翼电机启用 BLHeli 直通支持。

translations.english: When set to 1 this enabled verbose debugging output over MAVLink when the blheli protocol is active. This can be used to diagnose failures.
translations.chinese: BLHeli 协议启用时，设为 1 可通过 MAVLink 输出详细调试信息，用于诊断故障。

translations.english: This allows calculation of true RPM from ESC's eRPM. The default is 14.
translations.chinese: 设置电机极对数，用于根据电调 eRPM 计算真实转速。默认值为 14。

translations.english: This sets the inactivity timeout for the BLHeli protocol in seconds. If no packets are received in this time normal MAVLink operations are resumed. A value of 0 means no timeout
translations.chinese: 设置 BLHeli 协议无活动超时时间，单位为秒。若在此时间内未收到数据包，则恢复正常 MAVLink 操作；0 表示无超时。

translations.english: This sets the rate in Hz for requesting telemetry from ESCs. It is the rate per ESC. Setting to zero disables telemetry requests
translations.chinese: 设置向电调请求遥测的速率，单位为 Hz，按每个电调计算；设为 0 可禁用遥测请求。

translations.english: DShot ESC type for all outputs. The ESC type affects the range of DShot commands available and the bit widths used. None means that no dshot commands will be executed. Some ESC types support Extended DShot Telemetry (EDT) which allows telemetry other than RPM data to be returned when using bi-directional dshot. If you enable EDT you must install EDT capable firmware for correct operation.
translations.chinese: 设置所有输出使用的 DShot 电调类型。电调类型会影响可用 DShot 命令范围和位宽；None 表示不执行 DShot 命令。部分类型支持扩展 DShot 遥测（EDT），启用 EDT 时必须安装支持 EDT 的固件。

translations.english: DShot output rate for all outputs as a multiple of the loop rate. 0 sets the output rate to be fixed at 1Khz for low loop rates. This value should never be set below 500Hz.
translations.chinese: 设置所有输出的 DShot 速率相对于循环速率的倍数。低循环速率时，0 将输出速率固定为 1 kHz；不得设置低于 500 Hz。

translations.english: Number of motor electrical poles
translations.chinese: 设置电机电气极数。

translations.english: Position maximum at servo max value. This should be within the position control range of the servos, normally 0 to 4095
translations.chinese: 设置舵机最大值对应的位置上限。该值应处于舵机的位置控制范围内，通常为 0 至 4095。

translations.english: Position minimum at servo min value. This should be within the position control range of the servos, normally 0 to 4095
translations.chinese: 设置舵机最小值对应的位置下限。该值应处于舵机的位置控制范围内，通常为 0 至 4095。

translations.english: Range to map between 1000 and 2000 PWM. Default value of 200 gives full +-100 deg range of extended position command. This results in 0.2 deg movement per US change in PWM. If the full range is not needed it can be reduced to increase resolution. 40 deg range gives 0.04 deg movement per US change in PWM, this is higher resolution than possible with the VOLZ protocol so further reduction in range will not improve resolution. Reduced range does allow PWMs outside the 1000 to 2000 range, with 40 deg range 750 PWM results in a angle of -30 deg, 2250 would be +30 deg. This is still limited by the 200 deg maximum range of the actuator.
translations.chinese: 设置 1000 至 2000 PWM 的映射行程范围。默认值 200 对应扩展位置命令完整的 ±100° 范围；减小范围可提高分辨率，并允许使用 1000 至 2000 之外的 PWM，但执行器最大范围仍为 200°。

translations.english: Function assigned to this servo. Setting this to Disabled(0) will setup this output for control by auto missions or MAVLink servo set commands. any other value will enable the corresponding function
translations.chinese: 设置分配给此舵机输出的功能。设为 Disabled（0）时，该输出可由自动任务或 MAVLink 舵机设置命令控制；其他值将启用对应功能。

translations.english: Trim PWM pulse width in microseconds. Typically 1000 is lower limit, 1500 is neutral and 2000 is upper limit.
translations.chinese: 设置微调 PWM 脉宽，单位为微秒。通常下限为 1000，中位为 1500，上限为 2000。

translations.english: minimum PWM pulse width in microseconds. Typically 1000 is lower limit, 1500 is neutral and 2000 is upper limit.
translations.chinese: 设置最小 PWM 脉宽，单位为微秒。通常下限为 1000，中位为 1500，上限为 2000。

translations.chinese: 设置最大 PWM 脉宽，单位为微秒。通常下限为 1000，中位为 1500，上限为 2000。

translations.english: This allows for up to 32 outputs, enabling parameters for outputs above 16
translations.chinese: 启用 17 至 31 号输出，从而支持最多 32 路输出并启用 16 号以上输出的参数。

translations.english: Bitmask of outputs which will be available as GPIOs. Any output with either the function set to -1 or with the corresponding bit set in this mask will be available for use as a GPIO pin
translations.chinese: 设置可用作 GPIO 的输出位掩码。功能设为 -1 或在此掩码中置位的输出可用作 GPIO 引脚。

translations.english: Default output rate in Hz for all PWM outputs.
translations.chinese: 设置所有 PWM 输出的默认输出速率，单位为 Hz。

translations.english: Bitmask of scaled passthru output channels which will be set to their trim value during rc failsafe instead of holding their last position before failsafe.
translations.chinese: 设置 RC 失控保护期间要置为微调值的缩放直通输出通道位掩码；未选中的通道保持失控保护前的最后位置。

translations.english: This sets the SBUS output frame rate in Hz.
translations.chinese: 设置 SBUS 输出帧率，单位为 Hz。

translations.english: If set to 1 this auto-enables BLHeli pass-thru support for all multicopter motors
translations.chinese: 设为 1 时，自动为所有多旋翼电机启用 BLHeli 直通支持。

translations.english: When set to 1 this enabled verbose debugging output over MAVLink when the blheli protocol is active. This can be used to diagnose failures.
translations.chinese: BLHeli 协议启用时，设为 1 可通过 MAVLink 输出详细调试信息，用于诊断故障。

translations.english: This allows calculation of true RPM from ESC's eRPM. The default is 14.
translations.chinese: 设置电机极对数，用于根据电调 eRPM 计算真实转速。默认值为 14。

translations.english: This sets the inactivity timeout for the BLHeli protocol in seconds. If no packets are received in this time normal MAVLink operations are resumed. A value of 0 means no timeout
translations.chinese: 设置 BLHeli 协议无活动超时时间，单位为秒。若在此时间内未收到数据包，则恢复正常 MAVLink 操作；0 表示无超时。

translations.english: This sets the rate in Hz for requesting telemetry from ESCs. It is the rate per ESC. Setting to zero disables telemetry requests
translations.chinese: 设置向电调请求遥测的速率，单位为 Hz，按每个电调计算；设为 0 可禁用遥测请求。

translations.english: DShot ESC type for all outputs. The ESC type affects the range of DShot commands available and the bit widths used. None means that no dshot commands will be executed. Some ESC types support Extended DShot Telemetry (EDT) which allows telemetry other than RPM data to be returned when using bi-directional dshot. If you enable EDT you must install EDT capable firmware for correct operation.
translations.chinese: 设置所有输出使用的 DShot 电调类型。电调类型会影响可用 DShot 命令范围和位宽；None 表示不执行 DShot 命令。部分类型支持扩展 DShot 遥测（EDT），启用 EDT 时必须安装支持 EDT 的固件。

translations.english: DShot output rate for all outputs as a multiple of the loop rate. 0 sets the output rate to be fixed at 1Khz for low loop rates. This value should never be set below 500Hz.
translations.chinese: 设置所有输出的 DShot 速率相对于循环速率的倍数。低循环速率时，0 将输出速率固定为 1 kHz；不得设置低于 500 Hz。

translations.english: Number of motor electrical poles
translations.chinese: 设置电机电气极数。

translations.english: Position maximum at servo max value. This should be within the position control range of the servos, normally 0 to 4095
translations.chinese: 设置舵机最大值对应的位置上限。该值应处于舵机的位置控制范围内，通常为 0 至 4095。

translations.english: Position minimum at servo min value. This should be within the position control range of the servos, normally 0 to 4095
translations.chinese: 设置舵机最小值对应的位置下限。该值应处于舵机的位置控制范围内，通常为 0 至 4095。

translations.english: Range to map between 1000 and 2000 PWM. Default value of 200 gives full +-100 deg range of extended position command. This results in 0.2 deg movement per US change in PWM. If the full range is not needed it can be reduced to increase resolution. 40 deg range gives 0.04 deg movement per US change in PWM, this is higher resolution than possible with the VOLZ protocol so further reduction in range will not improve resolution. Reduced range does allow PWMs outside the 1000 to 2000 range, with 40 deg range 750 PWM results in a angle of -30 deg, 2250 would be +30 deg. This is still limited by the 200 deg maximum range of the actuator.
translations.chinese: 设置 1000 至 2000 PWM 的映射行程范围。默认值 200 对应扩展位置命令完整的 ±100° 范围；减小范围可提高分辨率，并允许使用 1000 至 2000 之外的 PWM，但执行器最大范围仍为 200°。
